_comment: Two unrelated defects that happen to share the pages namespace. zh-TW: privilege elevation rendered as physical height (海拔 sea-level altitude, 高程 survey elevation, 埃斯泰倫 phonetic noise); 薄荷海拔程式碼 is the worst of them, because 'Mint elevation code' was read as the herb -- the button said 'Peppermint Altitude Code'. Corrected to 提升權限, the term this pack already uses in 取得提升代碼. The lab summary was additionally in Simplified glyphs (只读/高级/测试/模拟) inside a Traditional pack, so it is restored to Traditional. he: HR-Systemverweis is raw German in the Hebrew pack; replaced using the pack's own established הפניית X pattern (compare הפניית סיכון, הפניית הדרישה שלך). AGENT DRAFTS -- native review still required.
